user.title: Hybrid Climate Setup
user.description:
Set up your whole-home HVAC orchestration system.

**Configuration found:** {zone_count} zones, {device_count} devices

data_description.master_name: Display name for the master climate entity

shared_equipment.title: Shared equipment
shared_equipment.description: Equipment that more than one zone depends on.

global_settings.title: Global Settings
global_settings.description: Configure the master entity, presence, outdoor sensors and limits, the device outage grace period, and the TOU rate sensor that electricity price adjustments use.

data.lockout_heat_floor: Maximum idle heat target during outdoor lockout

data_description.outdoor_sensors: Select sensor.* or weather.* entities in priority order
data_description.occupancy_entity: binary_sensor or input_boolean; when it changes, the master switches between Home and Away.
data_description.tou_rate_sensor: sensor.* entity whose state indicates the current rate period (e.g., 'peak', 'off_peak')
data_description.never_heat_above: Disable heating when outdoor temperature exceeds this value
data_description.lockout_heat_floor: Caps the next idle heat command; it does not immediately change an already-idle thermostat.
data_description.device_unavailable_grace: Keep a running stage during a brief device outage (seconds; 0 disables)
data_description.never_cool_below: Disable cooling when outdoor temperature is below this value

zones.title: Zones ({zone_count})
zones.description: Each zone shows its stages and regulation. Choose a zone to open its menu, add a zone, or delete one (you confirm first).

zone_basics.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Basics
zone_basics.description: Name and temperature sensors. With Weighted aggregation, each selected sensor gets a weight field below, labelled by its entity ID (1.0 is normal; higher gives it more influence). Save stores this page only; while adding a zone, Next goes on to the stage pages.

data_description.sensors: Leave empty to use device's built-in sensor
data_description.aggregation: How to combine multiple sensor readings
data_description.smoothing_samples: Number of samples to average (1 = no smoothing)

zone_setpoints.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Setpoints & occupancy
zone_setpoints.description: This zone's setpoints are number entities; change them on the entity or a dashboard: {setpoint_numbers}. This page sets occupancy; Save stores this page only.

data_description.occupancy_on_delay: Minutes presence must stay on before the occupied setpoints apply (0-120). Short walk-throughs are ignored.
data_description.occupancy_off_delay: Minutes to keep occupied setpoints after this integration last saw the zone occupied (0-120)
data_description.occupied_offset: Temperature adjustment when occupied (heating; cooling uses the Occupied/Unoccupied Cool numbers)
data_description.unoccupied_offset: Temperature adjustment when unoccupied (heating; cooling uses the Occupied/Unoccupied Cool numbers)

zone_heat_stages.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Heat Stages
zone_heat_stages.description: Configure heating stages. Stage 1 activates first; Stage 2 adds devices when Stage 1 can't keep up. Stages 3 and up are kept as saved. Save stores this page only.

data_description.stage1_threshold: Start heating when the room is this far below target
data_description.stage2_threshold: Add stage 2 when the room is this far below target
data_description.stage2_time_escalation: Or activate after Stage 1 runs this many minutes without satisfaction
data_description.stage2_outdoor_min: Only use Stage 2 when outdoor temp is above this (for heat pump efficiency)

zone_cool_stages.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Cool Stages
zone_cool_stages.description: Configure cooling stages. Stages 3 and up are kept as saved. Save stores this page only; while adding a zone, Save stores the new zone.

data_description.stage1_threshold: Start cooling when the room is this far above target
data_description.stage2_threshold: Add stage 2 when the room is this far above target
data_description.stage2_time_escalation: Or activate after Stage 1 runs this many minutes without satisfaction

zone_behaviour.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Behaviour
zone_behaviour.description: How **{zone_name}** starts and stops, pauses for open doors and windows, shares a running heat source, limits by outdoor temperature, and which wall thermostats it follows. Save stores this page only.

data.opportunistic_enabled: Use an already-running shared heat source (see Shared equipment → Heat source groups)
data.allow_command_devices: Wall thermostats that follow hand changes

data_description.min_runtime: Minimum time devices must run before turning off
data_description.entities: Binary sensors with on meaning open. Missing or unavailable contacts pause the zone immediately.
data_description.open_delay: Seconds a contact must remain open before the zone pauses
data_description.close_delay: Seconds all contacts must remain closed before the zone resumes
data_description.opportunistic_enabled: Allow this zone to piggyback on boiler cycles from other zones
data_description.opportunistic_threshold: Activate opportunistic heating when this far below setpoint
data_description.heat_limit_mode: Use house limit follows Global settings; No limit allows heating at any outdoor temperature; This zone's value uses the field below.
data_description.zone_never_heat_above: Only heat when outdoor temp is below this (used when the heating limit is set to this zone's value)
data_description.cool_limit_mode: Use house limit follows Global settings; No limit allows cooling at any outdoor temperature (e.g., for basements); This zone's value uses the field below.
data_description.zone_never_cool_below: Only cool when outdoor temp is above this (used when the cooling limit is set to this zone's value)
data_description.allow_command_devices: When someone changes the temperature on one of these thermostats, the zone target follows. A manual edit can affect every zone sharing this thermostat with sync enabled.

zone_regulation.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Regulation
zone_regulation.description:
Regulation for **{zone_name}**. Save stores this page only.

{heating_note}{cooling_note} The advanced sections apply to PI only and open collapsed.

data_description.regulation_type: How heating devices receive the zone target. Cooling regulation is set per device in the cooling sections below.
data_description.pi_devices: These receive a calculated equipment temperature, which may differ from the room target. Used only with PI.
data_description.regulation_threshold: Only send a new regulated setpoint when it moves at least this many °F. 0 = every change.
data_description.regulation_min_period: Minimum minutes between regulated setpoint changes. Target changes are sent at once. 0 = no limit.

data.integral_reset_threshold: Setpoint change that trims the integral

data_description.stabilization_threshold: Room error in °F below which the integral stops accumulating.
data_description.accumulated_error_threshold: Largest accumulated error (error × minutes) the integral can reach.
data_description.integral_reset_threshold: A target change of at least this many °F scales the integral down.
data_description.integral_reset_factor: Fraction of the integral kept when a target change trims it (0.3 keeps 30%).
data_description.integral_decay_halflife: Minutes for the integral to fall to half while the zone is idle. 0 = no decay.

data.cool_pi_compensation: Also correct the unit's temperature reading (Cooling PI)
data.cool_regulation_min_period: Minimum time between cooling correction changes

data_description.cool_regulation: How this device's cooling target is chosen: Use room target sends the zone target; Fixed cooling correction sends the zone target minus the correction below; Correct the unit's temperature reading lowers the zone target by how far the unit reads below the room (never raises it); Cooling PI lowers the target by a push the zone calculates from the room error (its gains are the zone's cooling PI number entities); Also correct the unit's temperature reading (Cooling PI), below, adds how far the unit reads from the room to the Cooling PI target.
data_description.cool_overdrive: Used only for Fixed cooling correction, while a zone calls for cooling; the zone still stops at its own target. Example: room target 72°F, correction 5°F → equipment target 67°F. 0 = off.
data_description.cool_compensation_max: Largest sensor correction in °F. Caps the correction both ways in Cooling PI with the unit correction, and as a push below the zone target in Correct the unit's temperature reading.
data_description.cool_pi_compensation: Cooling PI only: adds (unit reading − room reading) to the target, both ways, so the PI push is felt on the unit's own scale. Ignored for the first 3 minutes of each cooling run.
data_description.cool_max_total_push: Cooling PI with the unit correction only: the push plus the correction never lowers the target by more than this.
data_description.cool_compensation_sensor: Choose the temperature the unit uses internally, reported in °F (used as-is, no conversion); leave empty to use the climate entity's current temperature. The room sensor is chosen in the zone.
data_description.cool_regulation_threshold: A new correction is sent only when it differs from the last one sent by at least this many °F, and the minimum time below has passed. A changed cool target is sent at once.
data_description.cool_regulation_min_period: Minutes to wait after sending a corrected setpoint before sending another one. A changed cool target is sent at once.

data.cool_pi_compensation: Also correct the unit's temperature reading (Cooling PI)
data.cool_regulation_min_period: Minimum time between cooling correction changes

data_description.integral_decay_halflife: Minutes for the cooling integral to fall to half while the zone is idle. 0 = no decay.

zone_tou.title: Zone: {zone_name} - Electricity price adjustments
zone_tou.description: {tou_note}Configure Time-of-Use rate optimization. When a peak rate period is detected, the system pre-conditions before the peak and relaxes setpoints during the peak to reduce electric device runtime. Save stores this page only.

data_description.tou_heat_pre_condition_minutes: Minutes before peak to pre-heat (raise heat setpoint to warm up early)
data_description.tou_heat_relaxation_amount: Degrees to lower the heat setpoint during peak (reduce heating demand)
data_description.tou_cool_pre_condition_minutes: Minutes before peak to pre-cool (lower cool setpoint to cool down early)
data_description.tou_cool_relaxation_amount: Degrees to raise the cool setpoint during peak (reduce cooling demand)

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Choose a device to edit its heating/cooling support, idle action, compressor protection and coil dry-out. Cooling regulation is set on each zone's Regulation page.

device_edit.title: Device: {device_id}
device_edit.description: Edit this device's heating/cooling support, idle action, compressor protection and coil dry-out.{cooling_regulation}

data_description.can_heat: Device can be used for heating
data_description.can_cool: Turn on to show the coil dry-out settings on the next open.
data_description.action: Turn off or maintain a setback temperature
data_description.setback: Degrees below (heat) or above (cool) target when idle
data_description.compressor_group: Devices with the same group share compressor timing; leave empty to disable
data_description.min_compressor_runtime: Seconds the shared compressor must run before a normal stop
data_description.min_compressor_off_time: Seconds the shared compressor must remain off before restarting
data_description.cool_dry_out: When cooling ends, the unit runs fan-only for a while to dry the coil.
data_description.cool_dry_out_minutes: Afterward, the idle action applies. New heating/cooling or Off can end this early.

heat_sources.title: Heat source groups ({source_count})
heat_sources.description: Group devices that share a heat source (e.g., boiler) for opportunistic heating.

heat_source_edit.title: Heat Source Group
heat_source_edit.description: Configure devices that share this heat source. When one zone heats, others can piggyback.

data_description.devices: Climate devices that share this heat source

presets.title: Preset Modes
presets.description: Configure behavior for each master mode.

preset_edit.title: Preset: {mode_name}
preset_edit.description: Configure how zones behave in this mode. {remap}

data_description.use_zone_setpoint: Which set of zone setpoints this mode uses; for example Away can use the Sleep setpoints
data_description.setpoint_offset: Additional offset to apply to zone setpoints
data_description.disable_all: Turn off all zones in this mode

conflicts.title: Equipment that cannot run together ({rule_count})
conflicts.description: Configure device mutex rules. When a device is heating/cooling one zone, it can block other zones.

conflict_edit.title: Equipment that cannot run together
conflict_edit.description: When a device is active in a zone, it can prevent other zones from heating or cooling. {yaml_note}

data_description.device: The climate device this rule applies to
data_description.mode: Heating or cooling mode that triggers the block
data_description.for_zone: The zone that triggers the block when this device is active
data_description.block_heat: Zones that cannot heat while this rule is active
data_description.block_cool: Zones that cannot cool while this rule is active
data_description.blocked_devices_heat: Devices that cannot heat while this rule is active
data_description.blocked_devices_cool: Devices that cannot cool while this rule is active

error.source_devices_required: Please select at least one device.
error.source_id_exists: A group with this ID already exists.
error.no_blocks_specified: Choose at least one zone or device to block.
error.weights_needed: Weighted aggregation needs a weight for each sensor: set them in the fields below, then save.

abort.cannot_delete_yaml_source: Cannot delete heat sources defined in YAML. Remove from configuration.yaml instead.
abort.cannot_delete_yaml_rule: Cannot delete mutex rules defined in YAML. Remove from configuration.yaml instead.
abort.zone_not_found: Zone not found. It may have been deleted in another session.
abort.rule_changed: The rules changed since you chose this one (another session edited them). Nothing was deleted; open the list again.

state.stage_without_usable_devices: No available equipment can run this stage
state.holding_through_device_outage: Waiting briefly for equipment to reconnect

get_status.description: Return cached status and reasons. Administrator required; request a response.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry ID; optional only with one loaded entry.

get_config.name: Get configuration
get_config.description: Return effective tuning values and registered entity controls.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry ID; optional only with one loaded entry.

include_structure.name: Include structure
include_structure.description: Include read-only stages, device ownership, mutex rules, and TOU.

set_config.name: Set configuration
set_config.description: Validate tuning changes; dry run by default. Apply saves and reloads once.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry ID; optional only with one loaded entry.

global.name: Global
global.description: Global tuning fields keyed by field name.

zones.name: Zones
zones.description: Zone IDs mapped to dotted tuning fields and optional addressed stages.

devices.name: Devices
devices.description: Device IDs mapped to compressor timing fields.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Required human-readable explanation recorded in the audit trail.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Validate without saving; false requires expected_hash.

expected_hash.name: Expected hash
expected_hash.description: Stored revision from get_config or dry-run revision_before.stored.

restore_control.name: Restore control
restore_control.description: Run one manual restore pass over unowned, control-referenced devices (or one zone's), then report each requested device's outcome; a device outside the requested scope is never listed. Administrator required; request a response.

entry_id.name: Entry ID
entry_id.description: Config entry ID; optional only with one loaded entry.

zone_id.name: Zone ID
zone_id.description: Optional configured zone ID; restores only that zone's devices.

set_hold.name: Set hold
set_hold.description: Start or end one zone's hold. A hold keeps the zone at its current temperatures until it is turned off or, when until or duration is given, until that time; ending it resumes the saved temperatures. Administrator required; request a response.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The zone's climate entity or its Hold switch.

hold.name: Hold
hold.description: True starts (or retimes) the hold; false ends it and resumes saved temperatures.

until.name: Until
until.description: Optional end time for the hold; only with hold true, not with duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Optional hold length in minutes; only with hold true, not with until.

sensor_failure.title: {zone}: temperature sensors not reporting
sensor_failure.description:
The temperature sensors for zone {zone} ({zone_entity}) have stopped reporting, so Hybrid Climate has suspended control of this zone. Its devices stay tracked and shutdown limits still apply.

Check that the sensors are online, or choose different sensors in {page}. This issue clears on its own when the sensors report again.

device_unavailable.title: {device_name} is unavailable
device_unavailable.description:
{device_name} ({device}) is used by Hybrid Climate stages and has been unavailable for longer than the device grace period. Zones that use it run on their other devices until it returns.

Check the device and the integration that provides it. The grace period is set in {page}. This issue clears on its own when the device is available again.

manual_override.title: {device_name} was changed outside Hybrid Climate
manual_override.description:
{device_name} ({device}) no longer matches the mode or temperature Hybrid Climate last sent it; someone or something changed it directly. Hybrid Climate leaves it as set.

To hand control back, set the device back, or, when no zone is running it, press Restore control on {page}. This issue clears on its own when the device matches Hybrid Climate's command again.

stage_without_usable_devices.title: {zone}: no usable device in the active stage
stage_without_usable_devices.description:
Zone {zone} ({zone_entity}) wants its current stage, but none of that stage's devices can run: each is missing, unavailable, blocked by another zone or lacks the needed heat or cool capability.

Check those devices, or change the stage in {page}. This issue clears on its own when a device in the stage can run again.

pending_apply.title: Saved Hybrid Climate settings are not active
pending_apply.description:
A configuration change saved through the Agent API (hybrid_climate.set_config) did not become active; Home Assistant is still running the previous settings. The saved settings were not rolled back.

Open {page} and reload the integration; if that is not offered, restart Home Assistant. This issue clears on its own once the saved settings are active.
